name: Candidate screening
goal: Get from a pile of CVs to a fair shortlist in a day, not a fortnight.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I can help you screen candidates for this role. Ask me about the shortlist, the criteria or any CV.

answers.reply: Each candidate is scored against the must-have skills you listed. Anyone who meets every one goes on the shortlist, and the report says why for each person.
If you've said the role needs the right to work in Australia, candidates who haven't confirmed it are flagged, not dropped. Someone checks it before an offer.
Names, ages, photos and addresses are left out of the scoring. Every CV is read against the same criteria, in the same order.
If a candidate states an expected salary above the top of your band, it's noted in the report so you can decide before the interview.
Once the CVs are in, the screening report is ready in minutes. Most of the time left is the hiring manager reading the shortlist.

assistant.fallback: In the real app I'd answer that from your role details and the CVs. For now, try asking about the shortlist, right to work, fairness or salary.

steps.label: About the role
steps.goal: Tell us about the role, so every CV is checked against the same must-haves.

fields.label: Needs the right to work in Australia?
Must-have skills and experience
fields.hint: One per line. These are what every CV is scored against.

sample.Must-have skills and experience:
3+ years running end-to-end payroll for 500+ staff
Working knowledge of modern awards and Single Touch Payroll
Experience with a major payroll system
Reconciling payroll to the general ledger each month

steps.label: CVs
steps.goal: Add the CVs and anything that came with them. Each one is checked as you add it.

checklist.name: Candidate CVs
checklist.check: One file per candidate, with text that can be read
checklist.sample: Three CVs are scanned images, so the text can't be read

checklist.name: Cover letters
checklist.check: Matched to the right candidate's CV
checklist.sample: Two cover letters don't name the candidate and can't be matched

checklist.name: Selection criteria responses
checklist.check: Answers every must-have listed for the role
checklist.sample: Four candidates didn't answer the Single Touch Payroll criterion

checklist.name: Position description
checklist.check: Current version, matching the role title and salary band
checklist.sample: The position description is for the old Payroll officer role at a lower band

steps.label: Screening report
steps.goal: Here's how each candidate stacks up against the must-haves, and who should make the shortlist.

steps.label: Shortlist
steps.goal: The hiring manager sees the shortlist with the reasons, and signs it off for interviews.

config.confirmText: The recruiter will rework the shortlist using your note. Say who should be added or taken off, and why.
